title: St Peter's Ilmer Marriage Register
description: Marriages transcribed from 'The Registers and Records of St Peter's Ilmer' (Rex A Kidd, 1982), covering 1600-1969. Extracted automatically from the digitised PDF; free-text fields preserve the original transcription including uncertain readings.

year.description: Year of the marriage; null only if illegible in the source

date.description: Day and month, e.g. '10 Apr'; may be incomplete for a small number of entries

type.description: How the marriage was authorised, only recorded 1708-1837; empty for entries outside that range or where not stated

groom_forename.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

groom_surname.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

groom_age.description: Age at marriage, e.g. '23' or 'full age' (meaning 21 or over without a stated number); only recorded from 1838, so empty for earlier entries

groom_condition.description: Marital condition before this marriage; only recorded from 1822, so empty for earlier entries

groom_occupation.description: Occupation, where recorded alongside an age or condition; rarely present

groom_residence.description: 'otp' (of this parish) or a place name (the register's own 'of <place>' with the 'of' dropped); empty where no residence was recorded for the groom

bride_forename.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

bride_surname.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

bride_age.description: Age at marriage, e.g. '21' or 'full age' (meaning 21 or over without a stated number); only recorded from 1838, so empty for earlier entries

bride_condition.description: Marital condition before this marriage; only recorded from 1822, so empty for earlier entries

bride_occupation.description: Occupation, where recorded alongside an age or condition; rarely present

bride_residence.description: 'otp' (of this parish) or a place name (the register's own 'of <place>' with the 'of' dropped); empty where no residence was recorded for the bride

notes.description: Remaining free text: signing marks, officiating minister, witnesses, or register annotations
